text: The World Bank committed US$7.5 billion to disaster risk management projects in FY24, providing a context for scaling disaster risk financing solutions. The ASEAN+3 regional facility, established in December 2018 with China as a participating economy, aims to enhance financial resilience. Specific outcome metrics for China are not publicly detailed.

metadata.solution_name: World Bank Group’s Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance Program (DRFI/DRFIP)
